2607.13311.title: Finding the Right Tables and Columns: A Benchmark and Corpus-Adaptive Embeddings for SQL Schema Retrieval
2607.13311.paper_summary: Retrieval in the SQL setting has largely been studied as the task of finding, within a large collection of SQL statements, the statement that answers a natural-language question. At scale, however, a more fundamental retrieval problem precedes generation: schema retrieval, identifying the tables and columns a question requires in a database that may contain thousands of them, far more than fit in a model's context. We argue that this step warrants first-class evaluation. To this end, we recast five text-to-SQL datasets (Spider, BIRD, BEAVER, and two LiveSQLBench variants) as retrieval tasks at both table and column granularity, covering realistic and enterprise-scale schemas under two document representations, and we show that off-the-shelf text and code embedders transfer poorly to this setting. We then propose corpus-adaptive fine-tuning: natural-language queries are synthesized directly from the target schema corpus, granularity-aware hard negatives are mined, and a 305M-parameter embedder is fine-tuned contrastively. This procedure raises average recall@10 from 60.4 to 75.6 (nDCG@10 from 51.9 to 68.0), making the 305M model the strongest retriever under one billion parameters and competitive with state-of-the-art embedders of 4-8B parameters, more than an order of magnitude larger. The same recipe improves an 8B state-of-the-art embedder from 77.8 to 78.4 recall@10, matching the best result on the benchmark and indicating that the adaptation is backbone-agnostic. Leave-one-corpus-out experiments and a leakage audit show that these gains reflect a transferable schema-retrieval ability rather than memorization of the evaluation data. Our results establish schema linking as a standalone retrieval task and lightweight, label-free corpus adaptation as a practical route to deploying it at enterprise scale.
2607.13311.paper_summary_zh: 在 SQL 環境中的檢索主要被研究為在大量 SQL 語句中找到能回答自然語言問題的語句的任務。然而，在大規模情況下，更根本的檢索問題在生成之前就已存在：模式檢索，即識別問題所需的表和列，而這些表和列可能在一個包含數千個的資料庫中，遠超過模型的上下文所能容納的範圍。我們認為這一步驟值得進行一流的評估。為此，我們將五個文本到 SQL 的數據集（Spider、BIRD、BEAVER 和兩個 LiveSQLBench 變體）重新定義為表和列粒度的檢索任務，涵蓋現實和企業級的模式，並在兩種文檔表示下進行，我們顯示現成的文本和代碼嵌入器在這種情況下轉移效果不佳。我們接著提出了語料庫自適應微調：自然語言查詢直接從目標模式語料庫合成，根據粒度挖掘困難的負樣本，並對一個擁有 3.05 億參數的嵌入器進行對比微調。這一過程將平均 recall@10 從 60.4 提升至 75.6（nDCG@10 從 51.9 提升至 68.0），使得這個 3.05 億模型成為在十億參數下最強的檢索器，並與 40-80 億參數的最先進嵌入器具競爭，後者的規模大於一個數量級。同樣的配方將一個 80 億的最先進嵌入器的 recall@10 從 77.8 提升至 78.4，與基準上的最佳結果相匹配，並表明這種適應是與骨幹無關的。留一語料庫實驗和泄漏審核顯示，這些增益反映了一種可轉移的模式檢索能力，而非對評估數據的記憶。我們的結果確立了模式連結作為一個獨立的檢索任務，並將輕量級、無標籤的語料庫適應作為在企業規模上部署的實用途徑。
